opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for public tuition fee support, enrolled in an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HEI (including specific universities, Glasgow School of Art, Royal Conservatoire of Scotland, SRUC).
opportunities.summary: Grants cover the cost of tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students, up to £1,820 per year, for the academic year 2026‑27.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, with a place on a taught or research master’s programme beginning in 2026/27 at a Scottish university.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for eligible postgraduate master’s students to reduce tuition cost barriers, supporting full‑time or part‑time taught master’s programmes.
